failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named field — the error carries the expected format.

description: Edit a registered buyer's LHDN details — send only the fields you are changing. When tin is included it is re-checked against the same format gate create runs, and when state_code is included it is re-checked against the LHDN state table, so an edited buyer stays valid to generate against. Never touches e-invoices already generated for this buyer; each one sealed its own copy of the buyer party. NEXT: myinvois_customer_list to find the id.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at from a prior myinvois_customer_list/read. Mismatch returns CONFLICT with the current value.
